title: Correct free-fall acceleration
description: Essential: The response must state or derive the correct value of g = 4 m/s².

title: Correct release height
description: Essential: The response must state or derive the correct release height h = 72 m.

title: Correct impact velocity
description: Essential: The response must state or derive the correct final velocity v = 24 m/s.

title: Uses displacement in nth second
description: Important: The solution correctly applies the formula for displacement during the 6th second (s = h_6 - h_5) and relates it to the given 22 m.

title: Applies kinematic equations
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the equations of motion for constant acceleration from rest (s = 1/2 gt², v = gt).

title: Clear solution structure
description: Optional: The response presents a logical sequence, defining variables and showing the setup of equations before solving.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution includes correct units (m, s, m/s²) for all quantities and the final answers.

title: Misinterprets '6th second' displacement
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly treats the 22 m as the total displacement after 6 seconds or the displacement in the first second.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly handles the sign of acceleration or displacement relative to the chosen coordinate system.
